name: information-discrete-math
description: Information Discrete Math — a readout-first mathematical foundation. Loads before any math/physics/geometry to keep continuum concepts (real numbers, limits, angles/degrees, points of zero size, infinity, singularities) from being silently injected. Carries the contaminated-concept → discrete-replacement table, a pre-write checklist, and the machine-checked discrete number ladder D→ℤ→ℚ→ℝ with the retained-information operator.
